about: The voice-over of the demo video, one clip per scene. tools/demo.mjs paces each scene on its clip (voice/<id>.mp3) when --voice is given. The clips of the published demo were made with ElevenLabs (model eleven_v4, voice Matilda); any text-to-speech works.

scenes.say: Is your saddle at the right height? Saddle Check answers from a phone video, right in your browser.
First, film yourself from the side: phone on a tripod, the whole bike in the frame, shoes clipped in, and about a minute of steady pedalling.
Then drop your video here. The page reads it on your device, and once its pose model is loaded, it cuts its own network: nothing is uploaded.
For this demo, a synthetic rider stands in, so no real person appears. With your own video, an open pose model finds your joints in every frame.
You get the knee bend at the bottom of each stroke, against the range published for riders measured while pedalling,
and the saddle change, in millimetres, that would bring you to the middle of it.
Then every other angle, next to book or manufacturer guidelines, and a report to download and keep.
Tested on a home trainer: one saddle letter higher, the knee bent 4.8 degrees less, and three takes at the same height agreed within 0.7 degrees.
Saddle Check is free and open source. Try it on your own bike.
